title: ‘I really like where we’re at’: Apple CEO John Ternus explains company’s AI strategy and Siri...
hook_before: Apple CEO John Ternus just defended his company's artificial intelligence timeline.
script:
Apple CEO John Ternus just beat critics over AI timelines.
He told Moneycontrol he really likes where their development stands right now.
The comments follow recent user frustration over delays rolling out upgraded Siri features.
Rivals like Google and OpenAI have already shipped advanced assistant capabilities.
Ternus insists taking time to polish the software matters more than speed.
Will you wait for Apple to get it right?
